    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, a, common)

    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(b, c, a)

    sqrt (second_det ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = 2 * common
    first_det ^ 2 >= 0

    sqrt (first_det ^ 2) ^ 2 = first_det ^ 2

    first_det ^ 2 = sqrt (first_det ^ 2) ^ 2 = (2 * common) ^ 2 = sqrt (second_det ^ 2) ^ 2 = second_det ^ 2
    first_det * second_det = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) > 0
    first_det * second_det >= 0
    release thm f1::same_square_and_sign_gives_equality(first_det, second_det)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, a)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(1) = c(1) - b(1)
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(2) = c(2) - b(2)
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(1) = d(1) - a(1)
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(2) = d(2) - a(2)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(a, d))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - a(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)) = ((c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - b(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - b(1))) - ((c(1) - b(1)) * (a(2) - b(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (a(1) - b(1))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) - m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, a)) = second_det - first_det = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(b, c, a, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(b, c, a)
    by def $f3::are_parallel_lines(b, c, a, d)
